topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Well, the wheel turns, and a change comes to the village as it might in the fields, where one plot rests while another is sown anew. Old Martin, he tended the ledgers and the records, as steady as the seasons. Now, they say, he's off to the granary, to learn the weight of grain and the measure of our stores. I've known Martin since the last of the wars, when the winter was long and the berries failed. He knows the numbers, the ins and outs of what we owe and what we're owed. The thought of him in the granary, where the air is thick with dust and the quiet of the stored earth—it's a different air from the clerks' hall, where the ink flows as steady as the spring rains. I'll miss his company by the hearth, and the tales of numbers and days past. Still, change has a way of bringing its own harvest, if we are ready to sow and reap it. I suppose I'll visit him, see how he fares amidst the sacks and the shadows, and bring him an ale, for the old ways must be honored, even in new places.
